lead: Michael Sittow, also known as Master Michiel, Michel Sittow, Michiel, Miguel Sithium, and several other variants, was a painter from Reval, now capital of Estonia, who was trained in the tradition of Early Netherlandish painting.
paras: For most of his life, Sittow worked as a court portrait painter, for Isabella of Castile and her Habsburg relatives in Spain and the Netherlands, and other prominent royal houses.
